title: Compute Hom and Ext of presented polynomial modules

source.citation: Homalg: A meta-package for homological algebra, arXiv:math/0701146

translation.notes: The recovered Hom worksheet's two Q[x,y,z]-module presentations are retained. Noether computes Hom and the first two Ext modules; its nonminimal presentation differs from the historical display, so invariant ranks, vanishing and the Hom annihilator are recorded.
